name: Gulab
original_description: Gulab connects your Gulab account to a range of image and video generation models. Describe an image or a short clip and Gulab submits the generation and shows the result in the chat; videos run in the background and appear when ready. You can also save results into Gulab projects, upload reference images, check your credit balance and usage, and open your work on the Gulab canvas at gulab.ai. Generations use credits from your Gulab account.

limitations_ja: Gulabアカウントのクレジットを使用する。
